areas.name: Request continuity and appointment membership
areas.change: Bind follow-ups to the selected request rather than the most recently mentioned meeting. Preserve membership, explicit contact bindings, date/duration choices and confirmed-event identity. Reconcile source-bound per-appointment groups instead of flattening separate appointments.

areas.name: Recipient identity
areas.change: Carry human-supplied and approved mailboxes through planning and replay. Retain namesake/address ambiguity holds, missing-roster checks and authenticated requester identity. Explicitly labelled new participants can be added to an existing request without losing their address.

areas.name: Approval and request lifecycle
areas.change: Keep the concrete owner question, executable action and original requester together. Separate approval from confirmed action and notification delivery. Withdraw only the selected request. A proven arranger may request cancellation through the existing owner-approval path even when not an attendee.

areas.name: Scheduling evidence and clock authority
areas.change: Preserve scoped availability, actual rejection reasons and incomplete-provider uncertainty. Search and mutation consumers share the existing scheduling spine. Preserve exact human clock frames and the same source-bound calendar date across search and required-day checks.

areas.name: Holds and existing invitations
areas.change: Select holds from the delivered offer and preserve holder/event/request identity. Existing invitation corrections retain the real event; successful retries remain idempotent. Confirm cancellation before closing related artifacts.

areas.name: Concise answers with trustworthy receipts
areas.change: The execution planner produces the final answer and verified option IDs. Render clocks, groups and durations from structured facts. Retain complete questions and earlier typed action receipts when later reads occur; pending, failed and unconfirmed outcomes remain distinct.

areas.name: One interpretation and one answer writer
areas.change: Consolidate operation interpretation into the existing Haiku classification. Remove the additional Sonnet invitation interpreter, fallback scheduling writer and clock-choice judge from the candidate. Preserve the existing planner and output-gate tiers.
